title: The Vital Role of Sports Psychology in Preventing Children’s Involvement in Conflict: A Case for Kashmir
content: Sports psychology, as an interdisciplinary domain, is essential for cultivating psychological resilience and encouraging prosocial conduct among young, especially in conflict-affected areas. This article examines how structured sports programs, combined with psychological concepts, can function as preventive and rehabilitative mechanisms to reduce children's engagement in conflict. By utilizing local cultural affinity for sports such as cricket and integrating global best practices, these programs have effectively diminished aggressiveness, improved emotional well-being, and promoted community cohesiveness. Case studies from Kashmir, in conjunction with worldwide comparisons, highlight the transformative capacity of sports psychology in tackling socio-political difficulties and cultivating a generation adept at navigating intricate circumstances. The article emphasizes governmental and grassroots initiatives to institutionalize sports as a developmental instrument, promoting its extensive implementation and assessment.
